argout has a similar functionality to retval. The difference is that while retval can be used to return the result of the previous function, autargout can be used to return the result of a function. This can be useful if you are calling a function multiple times and want to return the result of each call.

argout and retval can be used interchangeably in some cases. However, autargout is more versatile and can be used to return the result of a function called from within the same function. This can make it easier to manage and reuse code.
